accounts_phone_confirmation_valid.name: accounts_phone_confirmation_valid
accounts_phone_confirmation_valid.value: "accounts"."phone_visit_confirmed_at" IS NULL OR "accounts"."phone" IS NOT NULL

admin_actions_actor_valid.name: admin_actions_actor_valid
admin_actions_actor_valid.value: ("admin_actions"."action" = 'admin.bootstrap' AND "admin_actions"."actor_id" IS NULL AND "admin_actions"."reason" = 'Initial Admin bootstrap') OR ("admin_actions"."action" <> 'admin.bootstrap' AND "admin_actions"."actor_id" IS NOT NULL)

master_products_published_image_valid.name: master_products_published_image_valid
master_products_published_image_valid.value: NOT "master_products"."published" OR ("master_products"."image_256_key" IS NOT NULL AND "master_products"."image_512_key" IS NOT NULL AND "master_products"."image_1024_key" IS NOT NULL)

onboarding_fees_status_valid.name: onboarding_fees_status_valid
onboarding_fees_status_valid.value: ("onboarding_fees"."status" = 'waived' AND "onboarding_fees"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND "onboarding_fees"."amount" IS NULL AND "onboarding_fees"."payment_date" IS NULL AND "onboarding_fees"."reference" IS NULL) OR ("onboarding_fees"."status" = 'paid' AND "onboarding_fees"."amount" IS NOT NULL AND "onboarding_fees"."payment_date" IS NOT NULL AND "onboarding_fees"."reference" IS NOT NULL)

onboarding_fees_date_valid.name: onboarding_fees_date_valid
onboarding_fees_date_valid.value: "onboarding_fees"."payment_date" IS NULL OR (isfinite("onboarding_fees"."payment_date") AND "onboarding_fees"."payment_date" <= (CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kolkata')::date)

order_status_history_statuses_valid.name: order_status_history_statuses_valid
order_status_history_statuses_valid.value:
"order_status_history"."to_status" IN ('placed', 'scheduled_pending_review', 'awaiting_customer_confirm', 'accepted', 'scheduled_confirmed',
  'preparing', 'ready', 'out_for_delivery', 'arrived', 'delivered', 'picked_up', 'rejected_by_shop', 'expired', 'not_collected',
  'cancelled_by_customer', 'cancelled_by_shop', 'delivery_failed') AND ("order_status_history"."from_status" IS NULL OR "order_status_history"."from_status" IN ('placed', 'scheduled_pending_review', 'awaiting_customer_confirm', 'accepted', 'scheduled_confirmed',
  'preparing', 'ready', 'out_for_delivery', 'arrived', 'delivered', 'picked_up', 'rejected_by_shop', 'expired', 'not_collected',
  'cancelled_by_customer', 'cancelled_by_shop', 'delivery_failed'))

rate_card_versions_scope_valid.name: rate_card_versions_scope_valid
rate_card_versions_scope_valid.value: ("rate_card_versions"."scope_type" = 'global' AND "rate_card_versions"."scope_id" IS NULL) OR ("rate_card_versions"."scope_type" IN ('area', 'category', 'shop') AND "rate_card_versions"."scope_id" IS NOT NULL)

shop_hours_times_valid.name: shop_hours_times_valid
shop_hours_times_valid.value: "shop_hours"."opens" BETWEEN 0 AND 1410 AND "shop_hours"."opens" % 30 = 0 AND "shop_hours"."closes" BETWEEN 0 AND 1410 AND "shop_hours"."closes" % 30 = 0

shop_listings_prices_valid.name: shop_listings_prices_valid
shop_listings_prices_valid.value: "shop_listings"."online_price" >= 0 AND "shop_listings"."online_price" <> 'NaN'::numeric AND "shop_listings"."counter_price" >= 0 AND "shop_listings"."counter_price" <> 'NaN'::numeric AND "shop_listings"."mrp" >= 0 AND "shop_listings"."mrp" <> 'NaN'::numeric AND "shop_listings"."online_price" <= "shop_listings"."mrp" AND "shop_listings"."counter_price" <= "shop_listings"."mrp" AND "shop_listings"."low_stock_level" >= 0 AND "shop_listings"."low_stock_level" <> 'NaN'::numeric

shop_listings_measured_rules_pair.name: shop_listings_measured_rules_pair
shop_listings_measured_rules_pair.value: (("shop_listings"."minimum_order_quantity" IS NULL) AND ("shop_listings"."quantity_step" IS NULL)) OR ("shop_listings"."minimum_order_quantity" > 0 AND "shop_listings"."minimum_order_quantity" <> 'NaN'::numeric AND "shop_listings"."quantity_step" > 0 AND "shop_listings"."quantity_step" <> 'NaN'::numeric)

shops_sent_complete.name: shops_sent_complete
shops_sent_complete.value:
"shops"."state" = 'draft' OR ("shops"."shop_name" IS NOT NULL AND "shops"."address" IS NOT NULL
    AND "shops"."pincode" IS NOT NULL AND "shops"."location" IS NOT NULL AND "shops"."owner_name" IS NOT NULL
    AND "shops"."entity_type" IS NOT NULL AND "shops"."pan" IS NOT NULL AND "shops"."fssai_number" IS NOT NULL
    AND "shops"."fssai_expiry" IS NOT NULL AND "shops"."upi_id" IS NOT NULL
    AND "shops"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL)
